- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden is a peaceful oasis with a mix of Japanese, French, and English landscaping, covering 58.3 hectares.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Getting to Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden from Shinjuku Station involves walking or taking the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line to Shinjuku-gyoenmae Station.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The garden is open from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with an admission fee of ¥500 (≈ $4.50 USD) for adults.
